summary: A legally-heavy morning with critical regulatory developments affecting retail operations and cross-border compliance, alongside significant corporate governance matters at India's top companies.

bullets.text: Delhi HC larger bench to decide if IP suits can be filed anywhere due to pan-India online product availability—critical for retail jurisdiction.
GCCs must navigate DPDP compliance alongside overlapping cross-border privacy regimes—urgent guidance for data-handling operations.
Delhi HC restrains FSSAI from cancelling ITC's licence over '100%' labelling claims—significant regulatory win for consumer goods sector.
Varun Beverages establishes alcohol subsidiary, expanding into new beverage category—major strategic pivot for company.
Mukesh Ambani's succession plan faces wildlife complications at Vantara—governance concerns at India's retail-retail conglomerate.
